messages:
carol: heads-up — during the handbook migration a couple TOCs collapsed and a few anchors broke in the runtime guide. link-checker surfaced 4 failures. can folks pick small edits for the editorial sprint? :wave:

sam: saw the alert. which pages exactly? can you paste the list so i can grab one or two?

carol: sure — quick paste from the audit:
```
- runtime/quickstart.md#examples
- onboarding/setup.md#credentials
- kb/kv-cache.md#ttl-behavior
- runbooks/scale.md#autoscale-policies
```

sam: i can take runtime/quickstart and onboarding/setup. will open tiny PRs (sed fixes to headings/anchors). :thumbsup:

mira: i can take kb/kv-cache but need an owner for runbooks/scale. @kevin, can you take that one?

carol: the link-checker command i ran was: `node scripts/link-audit.js --output broken.json` — attached the json to the issue. quick grep we used locally: `rg "^#" docs | rg -n "missing-anchor"` (helps find mismatches).

kevin: i can take runbooks/scale later today. also, can we add owners to frontmatter for these pages so the scanner auto-notifies the right squad?

docs-bot: Found 4 broken anchors across docs. Created temporary issue #1423. Tip: add an `owner:` field to frontmatter to enable auto-assignment.

sam: opened PRs #210 and #211 — tiny anchor normalizations, and a comment explaining the change. cc @carol for a quick review. i'll also add a one-line test that runs link-audit on changed files.

carol: thanks — can someone also add a short note to the migration changelog about TOC/anchor normalization? i'll draft the blurb if no one has time.

mira: quick question — when fixing anchors should we prefer hyphenated slugs or camelCase? we have a mix in old content.

carol: prefer kebab-case (hyphenated) — keep consistent with mkdocs slugify. use the existing heading text lowercased and hyphenated.

kevin: LGTM. i'll add `owner: platform-docs` to runbooks/scale frontmatter, run link-audit locally, and push a PR later today.

sam: will add a CI job that fails on new broken anchors (so PRs catch regressions). docs-bot will surface the failure message.

docs-bot: Note: automated link-check will start failing CI for merges next week. If a PR legitimately needs to skip the check, add `skip-link-check: true` in frontmatter and file a follow-up issue.

mira: grabbing kv-cache now — will ping when PR is up (small heading tweak + a note about TTL behavior).

carol: awesome, thanks all. if anyone wants to pair on the runbook change ping me; otherwise i'll shepherd the changelog and merge notes. :hand:
